caption: The video captures a wide, calm lake bordered by two densely forested green hills beneath a pale, cloud-covered sky, with the horizon line resting near the vertical middle of the scene. The lower half of the view is a mirror reflection of those hills and clouds, and the broad composition of silhouettes, tree line, and cloud pattern remains essentially fixed throughout. The main visible motion is in the water's surface texture, which exhibits slow, subtle rippling. Over time the band of reflected trees and the reflected cloud shapes shift slightly in clarity and waviness, growing a little more distorted at moments and smoothing at others, without the reflected geometry translating. Faint small ripple disturbances are visible near the lower-right water area. The framing appears stable, with no obvious pan, tilt, or zoom. No object is seen entering or leaving.
relations: Subtle surface ripples on the calm water cause the reflected tree line and cloud shapes to waver slightly without translating.
Small ripple disturbances near the lower-right water area locally perturb the otherwise mirror-like reflection.
The fixed composition of hills and sky persists while the water texture slowly shifts between smooth and slightly rippled states.
